description: React component implementing a login page that simulates authentication by setting a flag and navigating to dashboard without backend interaction.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component rendering a login form that uses state hooks for email, password, and submitting status, and handles form submission by setting authentication state and routing.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submit event by preventing default, updating submission state, setting authentication flag, storing demo user info in localStorage, and navigating to the dashboard route.
